questions.prompt: Which statement best summarises the central message of this lesson?
questions.answer: Robots solve defined tasks within conditions that must be tested.
options: Robots solve defined tasks within conditions that must be tested.
Every robot must have a human appearance.
Sensor readings are always complete and error-free.
The same instruction always works in every environment.
questions.explanation: Metnin genel sonucu: Robots solve defined tasks within conditions that must be tested.

source.en: Success should be measured through the performance of the combined work system rather than the speed of an isolated machine.
source.tr: Başarı, tek başına makinenin hızından ziyade bütün çalışma sisteminin performansıyla ölçülmelidir.

questions.prompt: Which statement is NOT supported by the lesson?
questions.answer: Every robot must have a human appearance.
options: Every robot must have a human appearance.
A small classroom robot follows a dark line painted on a light surface.
A warehouse tests a robot that carries boxes between work areas.
Success should be measured through the performance of the combined work system rather than the speed of an isolated machine.
questions.explanation: Diğer üç seçenek metinde bulunur. Seçilen iddia metnin verdiği bilgilerle uyuşmaz. Ana düşünce: Robots solve defined tasks within conditions that must be tested.

source.en: A small classroom robot follows a dark line painted on a light surface. A warehouse tests a robot that carries boxes between work areas. Success should be measured through the performance of the combined work system rather than the speed of an isolated machine.
source.tr: Metindeki destekleyici ifadeler yukarıda bir araya getirildi.

questions.prompt:
According to the lesson, is this statement true?
A robot does not have to look human.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Bu ifade metinde yer alır: Robotun insana benzemesi gerekmez.

source.en: A robot does not have to look human.

questions.prompt:
Choose the correct verb form.
Its sensors provide information that helps the controller decide how the wheels should _____ .
options: move
moves
moved
moving
questions.explanation: should yardımcı fiilinden sonra fiilin yalın hâli kullanılır: should move.

source.en: Its sensors provide information that helps the controller decide how the wheels should move.
source.tr: Algılayıcıları denetleyicinin tekerleklerin nasıl hareket edeceğine karar vermesine yardımcı olan bilgi sağlar.

questions.prompt:
What does “rather than” express in this sentence?
Automation can change the tasks people perform rather than removing every human role.
questions.answer: yerine; bir seçeneği diğerine tercih ederek
options: yerine; bir seçeneği diğerine tercih ederek
yalnızca kişinin adını belirtir
fiilin geçmişte tamamlandığını tek başına gösterir
soru sormak için kullanılır
questions.explanation: Bu cümlede “rather than”: yerine; bir seçeneği diğerine tercih ederek. Otomasyon bütün insan rollerini ortadan kaldırmak yerine insanların yaptığı işleri değiştirebilir.

source.en: Automation can change the tasks people perform rather than removing every human role.
source.tr: Otomasyon bütün insan rollerini ortadan kaldırmak yerine insanların yaptığı işleri değiştirebilir.

The team changes the layout as well as the robot's instructions to improve the overall process.
